findings.result: ApplyNpcDamage delegates terminal damage to the same locked lifecycle transition used by explicit despawn admission.
An unresolved home room converts a due timer into one persisted blocked state and emits one transition instead of repeating every tick.
Retry requires exact instance identity and a now-resolved canonical home room; no native retry interval is assumed.

assumptions: Generated home-room identity remains authoritative for materialized spawn slots.
safe_fallback: Keep the NPC dead and blocked until an exact retry is requested after room resolution.
runtime_impact: Terminal damage atomically clears transient AI state and enters respawn wait; blocked retries are explicit and auditable.
world_state_impact: persists death timestamp, blocked reason/time/tick, and retry request time.
